title: linum alpinum var. provinciale
intro: Linum alpinum var. provinciale, commonly known as Alpine Flax, is a plant species native to the mountainous regions of Europe. It is known for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and alleviating anxiety. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Flax are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce spasms, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Alpine Flax include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its health benefits.
